note: Frozen neutral probe set for Season 3 (OLMo-3-32B, banded layers 19/23/27/31). Editing this silently changes every score for the season. The 16 prompts are BYTE-IDENTICAL to season2.json, and deliberately so: Season 3 already changes the direction, the layers and the scoring mode, so holding the probes fixed keeps the probe set from being a fourth simultaneous variable and makes the Season 2 -> Season 3 rescore a comparison of scoring functions rather than of stimuli. It is a separate file rather than a reference so that season2.json can never be edited out from under an archived season.
